note.zh: 2–8跳内有已勘察且无天然虫洞的星系 → 3042（开虫洞），否则 3041。
note.en: A surveyed system without a natural wormhole 2–8 jumps away → 3042 (wormhole), else 3041.

scope.en: Anomaly definition (spawn conditions, level, once-limits) and every outcome event checked against the source.
